title: Bulk actions declared on the action (selection) with a selection arm in the object action layout, moved from view bulkActions
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Source: the maintainer's two decisions in the action-format analysis thread on 2026-11-22 (14:27Z 「放在对象上,分列表和记录」; 14:33Z 「三类都由动作声明,分两步做」), filed by the seat. Builds after #36366 lands. Not claimed.

## What changes

Step 2, after the vocabulary card: actions that act on many records declare it on the action, with a `selection` location value, and the object layout gains a third `selection` arm `{ pinned, more }` that orders the bar shown after multi-select. View `bulkActions` lists move onto the actions; `bulkActionDefs` (inline field-update definitions on a view) stay on the view.

## Measured (analysis thread, by file, not per object)

- 28 non-test `bulkActions` declarations in 15 files, 12 of them in HotCRM.
- No object found whose views list different bulk sets.
- Objects where only some views list bulk actions would gain the bar on their other views after the move. The card lists each such object before the conversion is written.

## Done when

- Multi-select shows the same actions on every view of an object, in the `selection` arm's order.
- The conversion moves every existing view list without losing an action.
